summary: Complete mid-sem study strategy for Energy Management and Audit (BE05000431 / MOPEC) — Government Engineering College, Bharuch, Electrical Dept. Covers all 5 units. Built from syllabus structure, marks weightage, and GTU exam format patterns since no PYQs exist for this new subject. Includes topic classification (theory/numerical/diagram), unit-by-unit breakdown, two study strategies (20/30 and 25/30), key formulas, and honest limitations.
